nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: Runs when another workflow calls this one. Input: ownerId, agentId, jobId, actorLabel, message, severity, data.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO agent_events
  (owner_id, agent_id, job_id, actor_label, message, severity, data)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5, $6::event_severity, $7::jsonb)
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.ownerId || null, $json.agentId || null, $json.jobId || null, $json.actorLabel || 'agent', $json.message || '', $json.severity || 'info', JSON.stringify({ ...($json.data || {}), runId: $json.runId || null }) ] }}

nodes.name: Insert event
nodes.notes: INSERT into agent_events with bound parameters ($1..$7). Severity must be info, ok, hold or block.

nodes.name: Return input
nodes.notes: Returns the caller's item plus eventId, so the caller's next node still has its fields.
